title.zh: v2.2.3 曲风库去掉重复播放键：点卡片即进详情并自动播放；全屏页面不再有底部导航
title.en: v2.2.3 The Library Loses Its Repeated Play Buttons: Tap a Card to Open and Play; Full-Screen Pages Drop the Tab Bar

highlights.zh: **每行一个一模一样的播放键确实丑，而且多此一举**：曲风卡片现在整块就是目标——**点一下进入该曲风详情页并自动开始播放**，色块只作身份标识（播放中显示暂停标记），不再是一个按钮。一次手势完成「打开 + 试听」。
highlights.en: **One identical play button per row was ugly and redundant**: the card is now the whole target — **one tap opens that genre's page and starts it playing**, and the colour square is identity only (it shows a pause mark while playing) rather than a control. One gesture does "open and audition".

highlights.zh: **曲风详情页里没有任何播放键**：页面上唯一的交通是**最下方的播放条**与左上角的收起箭头；**点页面任意非链接处、或点箭头，都回到上一屏**（页面上有一行小字提示）。「拿去即兴」保留，它是导航而不是播放。
highlights.en: **The genre page has no play control at all**: its only transport is the **player bar at the bottom**, plus the collapse arrow top-left. **Tapping anywhere that is not a link — or the arrow — returns to the previous screen** (a one-line hint says so). "Jam with this" stays: it is navigation, not playback.

highlights.zh: **全屏页面不再有底部导航**：进入全屏播放器或曲风详情页时，五格模块栏隐藏（内容底部留白随之适配），播放条在没有模块栏时贴到底部安全区；返回浏览时它再出现。
highlights.en: **Full-screen pages drop the bottom navigation**: the five-module bar is hidden inside the full-screen player and on a genre's page (the content's bottom padding adapts), the player bar sits at the bottom safe area when the module bar is gone, and the bar comes back when you return to browsing.
